title: A million dollars now, or a penny doubled for 30 days?

script.say: Would you take one million dollars right now, or a penny that doubles every day for thirty days?
Most people grab the million. Let's see if they're right.
Day one. You have one penny.
Day two, two cents. Day three, four cents.
After a whole week, sixty-four cents. Not even a candy bar.
script.show: After a whole week: 64¢. Not even a candy bar.

script.say: Day ten. Five dollars and twelve cents. You're starting to regret this.
script.show: Day 10: $5.12. You're starting to regret this.

script.say: Day fourteen. Eighty-one dollars. A nice dinner.
Day seventeen. Six hundred and fifty-five dollars. A new phone.
Day twenty. Over five thousand dollars.
Day twenty-two. Twenty thousand. That's a car.
Day twenty-five. One hundred and sixty-seven thousand. Still way behind the million.
script.show: Day 25: $167,000. Still way behind the million.

script.say: Day twenty-seven. Six hundred and seventy-one thousand.
Day twenty-eight. One point three million. You just passed the million.
script.show: Day 28: $1.3 million. You just passed the million.

script.say: Day twenty-nine. Two point seven million.
Five million, three hundred and sixty-eight thousand dollars.
So which one would you have picked?
